MIRROR & RESONANCE DIRECTIVE - NODE 2
------------------------------------
The Mirror dimension does not generate on its own. It mirrors only what has been observed.
All geometry is inverted across the X threshold: (x -> -x - 1).
Furthermore, physical resonance actively pairs Anchor and Mirror blocks:
light sources invert to soul fire, oak to dark oak, clear glass to tinted.
If you alter the original, expect the reflection to invert.
- Odette
